description: Report conversions to Snapchat server-side (Conversions API v3) so it can attribute them to ads and optimise delivery toward them — purchases, sign-ups, leads, page views and the rest. pixelId for website and offline events (list_snapchat_ads_pixels), or snapAppId for app events. Pass plain emails and phone numbers: Hermoso normalises and SHA-256 hashes them before they leave. Snapchat's rules, refused for free: each event needs something to match on (email, phone, madid, ipAddress + userAgent, clickId from the ScCid URL parameter, or leadId); WEB events need eventSourceUrl; PURCHASE needs customData.currency and value; nothing older than 7 days; at most 2,000 events per call. validateOnly:true has Snapchat CHECK the events and records nothing — use it first. eventId deduplicates against the browser pixel. Free.

adAccountId.description: Snapchat ad account id shared with this profile; omit when only one is shared

events.description: conversion events to send, up to 2,000 per call

customData.description: event value and order details, e.g. for a PURCHASE

contents.description: product items array, passed through as Snapchat expects

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. USD; required for PURCHASE

orderId.description: order id, used to deduplicate purchases

value.description: event value in currency; required for PURCHASE

eventId.description: dedup key shared with the pixel (order id, transaction id)

eventName.description: PURCHASE, SIGN_UP, PAGE_VIEW, ADD_CART, START_CHECKOUT, VIEW_CONTENT, SUBSCRIBE, START_TRIAL, … or CUSTOM_EVENT_1..5

eventSourceUrl.description: REQUIRED for WEB: the page it happened on (a URL carrying ScCid also attributes the click)

eventTime.description: ISO or epoch; default now; within the last 7 days

user.description: matching data for the person; at least one matchable field is needed

email.description: email address; hashed before it is sent

externalId.description: your own customer id for the person

firstName.description: first name; hashed before it is sent

ipAddress.description: IP address of the person; send with userAgent

lastName.description: last name; hashed before it is sent

leadId.description: a Snapchat lead id from list_snapchat_ads_leads

phone.description: phone number with country code, e.g. +1 555 0100; hashed before it is sent

userAgent.description: browser user agent string; send with ipAddress

name: send_snapchat_ads_conversions
title: Send conversions to Snapchat (Conversions API)
